items.title: Kiro Remote Workspaces: The IDE stays with you; the workspace moves
items.summary: A reference deck, with figures and screens, on remote workspaces in Kiro IDE (announced November 20, 2026). The IDE stays on your computer while the workspace runs in a cloud session, a dev container (on your computer or an SSH host) or your own compute, and the agent runs where the workspace runs. The deck compares the three ways (who provides the machine, what defines the environment, cost, networks and what you need) and shows how to open each one: Open in IDE, Kiro: Connect to Host… and Reopen in Container. Based on public sources as of November 21, 2026.

items.title: Kiro のリモートワークスペース: IDE は手元のままで、ワークスペースをクラウド、コンテナ、自前のマシンに置く
items.summary: Kiro IDE のリモートワークスペース (2026 年 11 月 20 日発表) を、図と画面で説明する参考資料です。IDE は手元のままで、ワークスペースをクラウドセッション、Dev Container (手元か SSH ホスト)、自前のマシンのどれかに置き、エージェントはワークスペースと同じ場所で動きます。資料では、3 つの方法の違い (マシンを用意する側、環境の決め方、費用、ネットワーク、用意するもの) と、それぞれの開き方 (Open in IDE、Kiro: Connect to Host…、Reopen in Container) を扱います。内容は 2026 年 11 月 21 日時点の公開資料によります。

items.title: Kiro for VS Code: Build with Kiro in the VS Code you already use
items.summary: A reference deck, with figures and real VS Code screens, on Kiro for VS Code (announced November 20, 2026). Installed as an extension in the VS Code you already use, it runs the same agent as Kiro IDE, so a team that mixes VS Code and Kiro IDE can work from one .kiro folder (specs, steering, skills, hooks, MCP and more). The deck covers where Kiro lives in VS Code, the context you pass with #, planning with specs, how much Kiro may do and how to undo its changes, workflows and memory, and getting started. Based on public sources as of November 21, 2026.
